        ticket_id = self.ticket_id_counter

            "customer": customer,
            "title": title,
            "priority": priority,
            "closed": False
        }

        # Order the queue by priority
        self.order_queue()

        ticket_id (int): The ID of the ticket to close.

        # Check if the ticket exists

            raise ValueError("Ticket does not exist")

        # Close the ticket

        ValueError: If the ticket is already closed.

        if ticket_id not in self.tickets:
            raise ValueError("Ticket does not exist")

        # Check if the ticket is closed
        if self.tickets[ticket_id]["closed"]:

        # Reopen the ticket
        self.tickets[ticket_id]["closed"] = False

        self.queue[self.tickets[ticket_id]["priority"]].append(ticket_id)

        for ticket_id in self.queue["normal"]:
